correctness.rationale: Both adjacency matrices defined on (Z/4Z)^2 are 6-regular and satisfy A²=4I+2J, yielding the common (16,6,2,2) parameters and spectrum. Hitting-time inclusion–exclusion over 2^15-1 nonempty forbidden subsets correctly converts max vertex-hit times to first exit times, and Cramer ratios of (6I-A[B]) give exact rationals. Distinct visited-set Bellman equations were independently implemented here with descending subset order and Gaussian elimination for both 16-vertex graphs: rook 55.120239522685985, Shrikhande 55.120643817526684, difference 0.000404294840699, matching the certificate interval (40429484,40429485)/10^11. This numerical solver independently corroborates the value/sign, not the many-digit certificate. Source exact_cover.cpp, cover_dp.cpp, verify.py and CERTIFICATE.json were inspected as supplied; exact 32767-subset determinant generation, not mere VERIFY_OK, is the claimed finite exhaustive certificate.
